question_answer: The unchanged current-frame repeated-grounding controller did not reach ARRIVAL in the frozen responsive replay.

largest_failure_cause: Current-frame candidate selection repeatedly issued left turns or oscillated across deterministic responsive viewports; 27/29 observations were reliable, but none produced the centered near cue plus fresh-frame confirmation required for ARRIVAL.
notable_episode: Episode e06 advanced from 15.55 m to 5.56 m from the OSM entrance proxy in 10 observations but still exhausted without ARRIVAL_CONFIRM.
reporting_note: The sealed raw result used an upper-middle value of 9881 ms for an even-sized latency list. This published closeout reports the conventional median, 9679.5 ms, derived from the six immutable episode summaries; no provider observation or scientific outcome was rerun or changed.
real_walkthrough_recommendation: WORTH_ONE_FUTURE_MINIMAL_RESPONSIVE_WALKTHROUGH_AFTER_EXPLICIT_AUTHORIZATION; the proxy exposed a control-direction failure, but viewport translation can itself create visual artifacts, so only a real turn-and-step check can separate simulator artifact from field behavior.
